{{Quote|1=This one is definitely Bith, a recording method of an isolated island race, the Aalagar, that concocted the knotting style as a means of recording genealogies&mdash;''&#39;''strings of ancestors.''<span style="padding-right:0.2em;">'</span>''<nowiki></nowiki>|2=Dr. Rotham|3=<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>}}
The '''Aalagar''' were a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. The Aalagar lived on remote islands, isolated from other Bith communities. The Aalagar developed a form of communication that involved tying knots of string to convey elaborate symbology. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] used a string of Aalagar symbology as part of a collection of [[Prophet/Legends|prophetic]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lorrd Artifact|tassels]] that she used to attract [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], whom she later turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Aalagar were one of the [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]]<ref name="DB" />&mdash;others included the [[Y'bith/Legends|Y'bith]]<ref name="Databank-Y'bith">{{DB|species|ybith|Y'bith}}</ref>&mdash;a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of highly advanced [[craniopod]]s.<ref name="Bith" />

==Society and culture==
The Aalagar developed a form of knot-tying in which they recorded their genealogy<ref name="DB" />&mdash;literally "strings" of ancestors.<ref name="Betrayal" /> This eventually evolved into a more complex form of communication,<ref name="DB" /> capable of conveying recorded thoughts and statements.<ref name="Betrayal" />

==History==
{{Quote|He will ruin those who deny justice.|An Aalagar knot string|<ref name="Betrayal" />}}
[[File:ClakdorVII-NEGAS.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Clak'dor VII, the Aalagar homeworld]]
The Aalagar lived on remote islands on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]],<ref name="DB" /> located in the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> As the result of a Bith [[Nozho–Weogar War/Legends|civil war]] centuries prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was transformed into a dangerous wasteland.<ref name="Bith" /> The Aalagar lived in isolation from the rest of the Bith species.<ref name="DB" />

Prior to the events of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] used an Aalagar knot string as part of a series of [[Lorrd Artifact|tassels]] containing [[Prophet/Legends|prophecies]] about [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]. The Aalagar strand contained the message "He will ruin those who deny justice." Lumiya left the series of tassels aboard [[Toryaz Station]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], trusting Solo would be attracted to the artifact, and in the process of discovering its meaning be led to her. Solo eventually obtained a translation of the Aalagar symbology from [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Heilan Rotham]] of [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]]. Knowing the tassels would bring Solo to Lorrd, Lumiya waited for him on the planet, and made contact with him shortly after his arrival,<ref name="Betrayal" /> beginning a relationship that would eventually lead him to become the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Caedus.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Aalagar were first mentioned in the [[2006]] novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]'', which was written by [[Aaron Allston]] and the first book in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series.<ref name="Betrayal" />
